name: Ghost Beam Synthetic Accelerator-Control Data Manifest
generator: JAX transfer-matrix digital twin with deterministic synthetic diagnostics

data_classes.beam_profile_images: Generated synthetic 2D heatmaps from the local twin.
data_classes.elog_corpus: Synthetic operator-memory rows stored in backend/data/elogs.csv.

provenance_disclosure: No real ALS, SLAC, Fermilab, Jefferson Lab, EPICS, camera, beamline, or facility eLog data are included.
hardware_disclosure: No real hardware is connected. EPICS support is a disabled stub in this MVP.
privacy_disclosure: No personal operator data, private logs, credentials, telemetry, or browser history are included.
replacement_path: Replace SimulatedEPICS with a facility-approved read-only adapter.
Map approved process variables into MachineSettings and SafeSignals.
Train virtual diagnostics on approved facility data.
Review eLog ingestion for privacy and facility policy.
Keep writes disabled until a hardware-safety gate approves them.
